_what_this_is: The test suites known to be RED, so a genuinely new regression can be told from the existing set. Read by tools/known_red_check.py. REPORT ONLY.
_how_it_was_measured: RE-MEASURED 2026-10-06 (fourth). Two passes. (1) tools/run_all_tests.py over the whole tree: 739 files ran, 3 SKIPPED (a precondition, NOT a pass), 84 FAILING. (2) Every failing file not already registered -- 74 of the 84 -- plus the 3 registered files the run showed GREEN, driven INDIVIDUALLY in its own process against a tree checked for drift after every suite. RESULT OF THE INDIVIDUAL DRIVE: 66 RED, 7 GREEN, 4 COULD NOT RUN (300s ceiling). The individual drive is the authority here and the whole-tree run is not, for the reasons in the next field.
_what_an_empty_why_means: NOT DIAGNOSED YET, recorded as empty rather than guessed. An invented cause is worse than a blank one because it ends the investigation. tools/known_red_check.py reports how many entries are undiagnosed, so a blank is a backlog rather than a shrug.
_what_this_is_NOT: Not an allow-list and not a gate. An entry does not make a failure acceptable -- it makes it ATTRIBUTABLE. An entry whose suite has gone GREEN is reported as RECOVERED and must be deleted: while it stands it swallows the next real failure of that file.
measured_against: EVERY suite in the tree, then every failing one re-driven ALONE. tools/run_all_tests.py drove 739 files (344 JS + 395 PY, 3 skipped) and reported 84 FAILING. All 74 of those not already registered were then driven INDIVIDUALLY, one process each, because that whole-tree run is NOT a trustworthy census -- see _why_the_whole_tree_run_was_not_trusted.

_why_the_whole_tree_run_was_not_trusted: THREE CONFOUNDS, each evidenced rather than suspected. (1) THE TREE MOVED UNDER IT: the log shows tests/sairnbiz_vendor_ytd_derivation.js PASSING, and at the time it was driven it failed at module scope -- cc pushed the anchor rename mid-run. tools/run_all_tests.py --pinned exists for exactly this and was not used. (2) THE RUN MUTATED THE TREE IT WAS MEASURING: tests/seam_check/run_delegation_probe.py left api/sd-data.js and api/_lib/subcontractor-compliance.js carrying planted sabotage, one of which is a redeclaration that does not parse. Four suites driven after it were re-driven on a restored tree and ONE of them -- tests/seam_check/run_probe.py -- went GREEN, so that confound changed at least one verdict. (3) THE RUN CORRUPTED THE CLONE: tests/push_gate/check8_probe.py left .git/config with core.bare = true and a fixture user identity, after which every git command in the clone fails with "this operation must be run in a work tree". Observed three times on 2026-10-06 and attributed by digesting .git/config after every suite.
_scope_limit_2026_10_06: RED IS MEASURED, DIAGNOSIS IS NOT. 66 of the entries added today carry an EMPTY `why`, which this file defines as NOT DIAGNOSED YET rather than nothing to say. That is a 66-item backlog, not a clearance, and it is the largest single addition this register has had. Every one of them was driven alone and its exit code recorded; none of them was read arm by arm. An entry makes a failure ATTRIBUTABLE, never acceptable -- and 66 undiagnosed entries is itself the finding, because tools/red_suite_register_check.py will now report any of them that recovers rather than letting the entry absorb the next real failure of that file.
